text: I am writing to express my deep dissatisfaction with the damaged books I received from your store and the indifferent attitude of your staff.
Last week, I ordered a set of reference books under Order Number 89214.
However, upon arrival, the book covers were torn and several pages were missing, which proved far from satisfactory.
What troubles me most is that your online agent failed to offer a clear explanation when I reported the problem, leaving the issue unresolved.
Therefore, I deem it imperative that prompt measures be taken to rectify this error through a replacement or a full refund.
I look forward to your favorable response soon.
